description: Connect your Nuwa Pen to ChatGPT. Search, recall, and summarize your handwritten notes using natural language. Ask what you wrote today, find notes about a specific topic, browse your notebooks, or view a rendered image of your handwriting — all without leaving the conversation. Nuwa turns your pen-and-paper notes into part of your AI workflow.

defaultPrompt: Can you give me a summary of my to-do's for today?
